definitions.explanation: A system of communication used by humans.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{言語|げんご}を{学|まな}ぶのは{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Learning a new language takes time.

notes:
{言語|げんご} is the formal and academic term for "language" as a system of communication. It appears frequently in scholarly, technical, and official contexts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {言語|げんご}{学|がく}: linguistics
- {言語|げんご}{能力|のうりょく}: language ability/proficiency
- {言語|げんご}{障害|しょうがい}: speech/language disorder
- {言語|げんご}{療法|りょうほう}: speech therapy
- {公用|こうよう}{言語|げんご}: official language

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言語|げんご}: formal/academic; refers to language as a system
- {言葉|ことば}: everyday word; also covers words, speech, and expressions
- {国語|こくご}: national language (school subject in Japan)
- {語|ご}: language as a suffix ({日本語|にほんご}, {英語|えいご})
